newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - At Home rated neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - At Home rated neutral.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter said it initiated coverage of At Home Corp with a neutral rating.
-- said near-term shares are fairly valued.
-- said long-term believes shares will outperform the market as the company continues to build out its network and customer base.
-- Analysts Mary Meeker and Richard Bilotti said they are "extremely optimistic" about the outlook for At Home's business.

-- Morgan Stanley was the lead underwriter of the company's July initial public offering. Shares were priced at $10.50 but quickly shot higher, closing Monday at 22-1/8. The company's market capitalization is up 110 percent from the IPO, from $1.25 billion to $2.6 billion.
-- said stock could very well benefit short-term if market bullishness continues due to enthusiasm for Internet-related companies and liquidity squeeze.
